risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (391.84) with FOMC event just passed creates severe near-term volatility headwind; normal yield curve and flat DXY provide limited offset; 55-day earnings window adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term structure (EMA 50/200 bullish, supertrend, price above SMA 200) with contrarian buy signal in extreme fear zone (VIX 391.84) offers asymmetric risk/reward for patient entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, post-FOMC volatility), absent volume confirmation, negative money flow, weak short-term momentum, zero smart money conviction, and 55-day earnings event risk make immediate entry premature and dangerous.
